name: Egress Protocol
summary:
“Ah, you’ve stumbled in, have you? Welcome, welcome… to my escape room.

Don’t look so nervous. You like puzzles, don’t you? Locks, codes, switches... oh, the lot. You’ll have your chance to fiddle with them while I sit back and watch. It's all part of the fun.

But I must admit, I’m most curious about you. How long can you keep up that little mask of yours? How long before you stop pretending to be frightened, and simply enjoy yourself? I know what you are. And soon enough, so will you.

Oh, don’t pout… it’s nothing personal, is it? You were invited. And now, you’re part of the protocol.

So, shall we begin?”

This game was created in just three days as part of a personal challenge. The theme, gameplay and scenario was chosen with a random game ideas generator. It’s a short experimental project, so expect a focused experience rather than a full-length game.

All credits for assets, 3D models, and music are listed in the About menu.
